title: 第22章 重礼第23章 儒道春秋
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
看张远身上气血激荡，徐珂摇摇头，面上露出一丝笑意。
这才是年轻人该有的样子。
“这件事不能计功勋，奖励不能以军功论。”
“不能违背镇抚司规矩，只能算是韩司首和我们对你的特殊奖励。”
特殊奖励，不算军功，不能违背镇抚司规矩。
甚至这件事往后都不能外传。
自然，以此奖励入玄甲卫和查探大哥殉职消息也都不成了。
张远心中有些失落。
好在玉娘下午帮他分析时候，就说过这样的功劳恐怕不能公开，能换的好处不会太多。
囚军之事，金城陆囚禁庐阳府镇抚司十年事情，都不能公开。
“司首大人，卑职只是寻常皂衣卫，才顶职入镇抚司，对于奖励之事并不清楚，还望大人做主。”张远向着徐珂抱拳，朗声开口。
玉娘说这叫以退为进。
张远的话让墟徐珂双目之中透出一丝精光。
“有点意思。”看着张远，徐珂点点头，拿出一块青色的玉牌。
“凭此令牌，可以去典籍司选一份功法。”
……
张远走出小院，握紧手中玉牌。
镇抚司典籍司中可以选功法，这是之前不敢想之事。
这样的奖励，不是金银财货能比。
这才是最合适的。

压住心中的急迫，张远舒一口气，收起玉牌。
要选什么功法，需要好好想清楚。
这样的机会，不能贸然浪费。
“张远，有没有兴趣入甲三队？”小院门口，穿着黑色皂衣的青年忽然开口。
张远微微一愣。
“我是甲三队旗官卢阳朝，你若是想来甲三队，我可以寻孙泽要人。”看着张远，皂衣青年再次出声。
加入甲三队就有争夺玄甲卫身份的资格！
张远面上露出一丝激动，低声道：“卢旗官，若是我入甲三队，你能不能助我成为玄甲卫。”
“玄甲卫？”卢阳朝看着张远，仔细打量一番，摇摇头。
“别说我无信心帮你争夺玄甲卫，便是有那个能力，我也不能以我甲三队兄弟性命来帮你搏军功。”
“一府镇抚司想出一位玄甲卫，太难。”
卢阳朝遗憾的摇头，转身就走。
张远的条件他无法满足，再说其他也没有意思。
content_en:
Seeing the surging energy and blood in Zhang Yuan's body, Xu Ke shook his head with a smile on his face.
This is what young people should be like.
"This matter cannot be counted as meritorious service, and the reward cannot be based on military merit."
"You can't violate the rules of the Zhenfu Department. It can only be regarded as a special reward from Chief Han and us to you."
Special rewards do not count as military merit and cannot violate the rules of the Zhenfu Department.
Even this matter cannot be spread out in the future.
Naturally, this reward for entering Xuan Jiawei and investigating the news of the elder brother's death in the line of duty are useless.
Zhang Yuan felt a little disappointed.
Fortunately, when Yu Niang was helping him analyze in the afternoon, she said that such credit probably could not be made public, and there would not be many benefits in exchange for it.
The matter of imprisoning the army and Jincheng Lu imprisoning Luyang Prefecture Zhenfusi for ten years cannot be made public.
"Master Chief of the Division, I was just an ordinary guard in soap clothes, and I joined the Zhenfu Division. I don't know about the rewards. I hope you will make the decision." Zhang Yuan clasped his fists towards Xu Ke and spoke loudly.
Yu Niang said that this is called retreat to advance.
Zhang Yuan's words made Xu Ke's eyes shine with a glimmer of light.
"It's interesting." Looking at Zhang Yuan, Xu Ke nodded and took out a green jade plaque.
"With this token, you can go to the Classics Department to choose a technique."
…
Zhang Yuan walked out of the small courtyard and held the jade token in his hand tightly.
You can choose martial arts in the Classics Department of the Zhenfu Department, which was something I didn't dare to think about before.
Such a reward cannot be compared to gold and silver.
This is the most appropriate.
Suppressing the urgency in his heart, Zhang Yuan breathed a sigh of relief and put away the jade token.
You need to think carefully about which exercise to choose.
This kind of opportunity cannot be wasted hastily.
"Zhang Yuan, are you interested in joining the A-3 team?" At the entrance of the small courtyard, a young man wearing black soap clothes suddenly spoke.
Zhang Yuan was slightly startled.
"I am Lu Yangchao, the flag officer of Team A3. If you want to come to Team A3, I can ask Sun Ze for someone." Looking at Zhang Yuan, the young man in soap clothes spoke again.
If you join Team A3, you will be eligible to compete for the identity of Xuanjiawei!
There was a hint of excitement on Zhang Yuan's face, and he whispered: "Lu Qiguan, if I join the third team, can you help me become a Xuanjia guard?"
"Xuanjia Guard?" Lu Yangchao looked at Zhang Yuan, looked at it carefully, and shook his head.
"Don't say that I don't have the confidence to help you fight for the Xuanjia Guard. Even if I have that ability, I can't sacrifice the lives of my brothers from the Third Team to help you fight for military glory."
"It's too difficult for Yifu Zhenfu Division to come up with a Xuanjia Guard."
Lu Yangchao shook his head regretfully, turned around and left.
He couldn't meet Zhang Yuan's conditions, and there was no point in talking about anything else.
